headerDisplay: Every scene of your Wi-Fi Nanoleaf devices appears in HomeKit as a switch; add the switches to Home app scenes. Devices on your network are found automatically. To pair a device, enable **Connect to API** in its settings in the Nanoleaf app (or hold its power button for 5-7 seconds) while Homebridge is running.
footerDisplay: If this plugin lights up your home, you can [buy me a coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/palmaiz) ☕

discovery.title: Find Nanoleaf devices on the network automatically

devices.title: Devices added by address

host.title: IP address or hostname
host.description: Use a fixed IP (DHCP reservation) or the device's .local hostname.

token.title: Auth token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty to pair automatically by holding the power button for 5-7 seconds.

devices.description: Only needed for devices that automatic discovery cannot find (e.g. on another network without an mDNS reflector).

offAction.title: Turning off the active scene's switch

oneOf.title: Switches back to the previous scene

namePrefix.title: Name prefix
namePrefix.description: Optional text put in front of every scene name in HomeKit.

include.title: Only these scenes
include.description: Normally set with the scene list above. If set, only these scenes are exposed.

exclude.title: Hide these scenes
exclude.description: Normally set with the scene list above.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Changes are normally pushed instantly by the device; polling is only a fallback and picks up new scenes.

layout.title: Scene list (set by the ticks above)
